docs.title: Overview
docs.attribution: © Netlify, Inc. — via docs.netlify.com llms.txt interface
docs.snippet: The Cache API is a programmatic interface for reading and writing HTTP responses to a cache using the standard CacheStorage and Cache JavaScript APIs.

docs.title: Features
docs.attribution: © Netlify, Inc. — via docs.netlify.com llms.txt interface
docs.snippet: The Cache API uses standard cache control headers to determine the cache behavior for a response. This includes how long it can be cached for, how it's matched against a request and how it can be invalidated.

docs.title: API reference
docs.attribution: © Netlify, Inc. — via docs.netlify.com llms.txt interface
docs.snippet: The Cache API offers the following methods, a subset of the standard CacheStorage and Cache APIs.

docs.title: `caches.match`
docs.attribution: © Netlify, Inc. — via docs.netlify.com llms.txt interface
docs.snippet: caches.match

docs.title: Parameters
docs.attribution: © Netlify, Inc. — via docs.netlify.com llms.txt interface
docs.snippet: - **request:** the request for which you are attempting to find responses in the caches; this can be a Request object or a URL string

docs.title: Return value
docs.attribution: © Netlify, Inc. — via docs.netlify.com llms.txt interface
docs.snippet: A Promise that resolves to the Response associated with the first matching request in any of the caches. If no match is found, the Promise resolves to undefined.

docs.title: `caches.open`
docs.attribution: © Netlify, Inc. — via docs.netlify.com llms.txt interface
docs.snippet: The name parameter defines a namespace for a specific set of cached responses. You should use something meaningful for your application context.

docs.title: Return value

docs.snippet: Return value

docs.title: Parameters
docs.attribution: © Netlify, Inc. — via docs.netlify.com llms.txt interface
docs.snippet: - **request:** a request for the resource you want to add to the cache; this can be a Request object or a URL string

docs.title: Parameters
docs.attribution: © Netlify, Inc. — via docs.netlify.com llms.txt interface
docs.snippet: - **request:** the request for which you are attempting to find responses in the cache; this can be a Request object or a URL string

docs.title: Return value
docs.attribution: © Netlify, Inc. — via docs.netlify.com llms.txt interface
docs.snippet: A Promise that resolves to the Response associated with the first matching request in the cache. If no match is found, the Promise resolves to undefined.
